acceptanceCriteria: A whole-file L1 write is judged by history-append-only, dep-exact-pin, dep-one-per-capability, ts and python no-phantom-import and security-patterns through one shared pre-tool file adapter
An L1 edit fragment is never judged as a whole document and a read-only call is never judged as a write
The consumer harness config loads the typescript and python packs so those rules can fire
diagnosis: Reproduced: a Write of a rewritten history file, a package.json with a range, a ts file importing a missing package or calling the dynamic-eval sink, and the python equivalents each pass the L1 hook silently in a consumer repo. Root cause: hookScope sets files: [] and carries the tool call in proposedPaths/proposedContent, but history-append-only, dep-exact-pin, dep-one-per-capability and the ts/python phantom and security-patterns enforcers loop ctx.scope.files and read the disk, so none sees the L1 call; the consumer harness also loaded no ts/python pack.
